title: Handover-Prediction-Thesis: timestamp-alignment audit and leakage-audited multi-horizon handover forecasting from LTE drive-test signalling
description: Code, derived tables and drive-test logs for the B.Sc. thesis Conformalized Discrete-Time Hazard Modeling for Multi-Horizon Handover Forecasting in Cellular Networks (Islamic University of Technology, 2026) and the journal manuscript Timestamp-Alignment Leakage in Drive-Test Handover Prediction: Quantification, Mitigation, and Blind Second-Operator Validation. Includes the one-hertz export alignment audit, the one-row lag decomposition, the splitting-protocol ladder, the discrete-time hazard models, and the blind second-operator test. Current results: stages 22 to 32; tables in pipeline/reports_rev_parserfix and pipeline/second_operator.
